verdict.rationale: Plausible documents an 'Export stats: download your data' feature and a Stats API that returns metrics as JSON, an open format. CSV import, the self-hostable Community Edition, and community notes that it is FOSS also support leaving without lock-in. However, the evidence never states the export file format or that the export covers all data rather than aggregated stats. Missing for 10: explicit export format (e.g. CSV) in the export docs, evidence that the export is complete (raw events, all sites and properties), independent or hands-on corroboration of a full export-and-migrate flow.
